transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Well, I'm here because of what's been happening at work. I operate a truck down at the warehouse, and... well, the routing system we use isn't just a regular computer to me anymore. I know it's been marking my moves. It's actually sending messages through our scanners to push me out. I figure it's because I'm one of the old hands there, but... yeah, that's what brings me in today.
Can you tell me more about how the routing system marks your moves and sends messages through the scanners? Do you believe the system has a specific intent or plan against you?

Well, like I was just saying, the whole plan is to push me out. It's... it's not just logging my inventory like it's supposed to. 

When I use the hand scanner on a pallet, it flashes these specific codes, routing my truck to the complete opposite side of the warehouse. It tracks exactly where I am on the floor and then deliberately messes up my route times. It's sending a message to the supervisors that I can't keep up anymore, making me look incompetent. 

So, yeah, I absolutely believe it has an intent. It's not a glitch. It's a targeted plan to get rid of the older guys who have been there a while, and I'm the one it's focused on right now.
Have you noticed any other things in your environment acting strangely or giving you messages, like sounds, voices, or other signs that others might not notice?

Well, yeah, actually. It's not just at the warehouse. Even when I'm at home, sitting out in my garage with everything completely shut off... I hear them. 

It's the dispatch voices. I hear them clear as day, just like they're coming over a radio. They keep calling out my operator number. They say things like... they say I'm dangerous, or they tell me that security is coming to get me. It's loud and clear, even when there's no radio around.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood lately, like feeling unusually down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Everything just feels... flat. I don't really care about much of anything anymore. 

I used to love fishing, singing in the choir, and just tinkering with wood out in the garage. Those things used to settle me down, you know? But lately... I can walk right past my rods or my tools, look right at them, and I just feel nothing. There's no pull to touch them or do anything with them. I just don't have the energy or the interest anymore.
Do you ever feel like certain events, objects, or people in your life have special meanings or connections that others don't seem to notice?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, besides the scanners at work and the dispatch voices I told you about, there aren't any other special signs or anything. It's just... it's just the stuff at the warehouse and the voices in my garage. Everything else is just normal, I guess. I don't see hidden meanings in random objects or people on the street, if that's what you mean.
Do you ever feel like people you don’t know are involved in this plan against you, or do you believe this is something limited to your workplace and the system they use there?

No, it's... it's just the warehouse. I don't think random people on the street are involved or anything. It's the routing system at work. It's not just a computer to me anymore. I know it's been marking my moves, keeping track of everything I do. It sends messages through the scanners... trying to push me out. I think it's because I'm one of the old hands, you know? I've been there a long time, and they want me gone, so the system is targeting me. But it's just there, at the job.
Do you ever feel like the routing system or the dispatch voices are controlling your actions or putting thoughts into your mind that aren't your own?

No, I wouldn't say that. They aren't controlling what I do, and they aren't putting thoughts in my head. My thoughts are my own. 

The system just... it tracks me, and it sends those messages to try and push me out. And the voices in the garage, they just talk. But nobody is pulling my strings or making me do things I don't want to do. I'm still the one making my own decisions and moving my own hands. It's just that they're watching every move I make.
Have you ever had the feeling that someone or something outside of the warehouse system is trying to harm you or is out to get you in any way?

No, it's really just the warehouse. Like I said, I'm here because of that routing system. It's not just a regular computer setup anymore. I know it's marking my moves, keeping tabs on me. It sends those messages through the scanners to try and push me out because I've been there so long. I'm one of the old hands, and they want me gone. But outside of work... no, I don't feel like anyone else is out to get me. It's just the system at the job.
Have you ever felt that your actions, thoughts, or feelings were being directly influenced or controlled by something outside of yourself, like a force or power you couldn’t see?

No, I don't feel like I'm being controlled by some outside force or anything like that. Like I mentioned before, it's really just the routing system at the warehouse. It's not just a regular computer... I know it's marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners to push me out, just because I'm one of the older guys there. But it's not controlling my mind or my actions. It's just watching me and trying to get rid of me.

Do you believe the routing system at work is something normal, like a regular computer system, or do you think it has some unusual, almost supernatural abilities, like being alive or having a mind of its own?

Well... I wouldn't say it's supernatural, like a ghost or magic or anything. But it's definitely not just a regular computer anymore. 

Like I was saying, it's... it's like it knows. It's marking my moves specifically. It's sending those messages through the scanners directly at me to try and push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands and I've been there so long. A normal computer wouldn't care who I am or how long I've worked there. But this system... it's doing it on purpose to get rid of me.
Do you believe the routing system at work is specifically targeting you in a way that feels like a personal attack or part of a deliberate effort to harm or remove you from your job?

Yes, that's exactly it. I know I keep repeating myself, but... yes. It feels completely personal. 

Like I said, it's just not a normal computer to me anymore. I know for a fact it has been marking my moves out there on the floor. It sends those messages right through my scanner, and it's a deliberate effort to push me out. I've been driving the trucks there a long time, I'm one of the old hands, and it just wants me gone. So, yes, it is absolutely targeting me to remove me from my job.
Have you ever felt that anything else in your life—besides the routing system at work—is acting with its own intention or purpose against you in a similar way?

No, I haven't noticed anything else like that. It's really just the situation at work. Like I've been saying, I'm here because that routing system at the warehouse... it's just not a normal computer to me anymore. I know it's been marking my moves and sending those messages through the scanners to push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands. But outside of the warehouse, no, I don't feel like anything else is acting against me. It's just that system at work.
Have you ever questioned whether the routing system is actually targeting you, or do you feel completely certain about it despite others not seeing it the same way?

I don't really question it. I'm certain. I know I keep coming back to this same point, but that's exactly why I'm here. 

That routing system at the warehouse... it just isn't a computer to me anymore. Other people can think what they want, but I know what I see. I know it has been marking my moves out there. I see the messages it sends right through the scanners, and I know it's doing it to push me out just because I'm one of the old hands. So, no, I don't doubt it at all. I'm completely sure of it.
Have you ever felt that your mood or emotions were connected to these experiences with the routing system, or have they always felt separate from how you were feeling emotionally?

Yeah, I'd say they were connected. When I was at my absolute lowest... I mean, when I was barely eating, not going to choir anymore, and just feeling like I had failed everybody... the scanner messages and the dispatch voices were happening right along with it. So, no, they didn't really feel separate. It all kind of happened together.

Do you believe that the routing system at work is acting in a way that, while unusual, could still be possible in the real world, or do you think it’s doing things that completely defy the laws of nature or technology as you understand them?

I don't really know about the laws of nature or anything like that. I just know what's actually happening. 

Like I've been saying... I'm here because that routing system at the warehouse, it just isn't a normal computer to me anymore. I don't know exactly how it's doing it technologically, but I know it has been marking my moves out on the floor. It's sending those messages right through the scanners specifically to push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands. 

So... to me, it's happening right here in the real world, whether it makes sense to anybody else's understanding of technology or not.
Do the messages and actions of the routing system feel connected to your low mood, or do they feel like something completely separate and unrelated to how you've been feeling emotionally?

Well, like I think I just mentioned a minute ago, yeah, they definitely feel connected. 

When I was at my absolute lowest point... you know, when I was barely eating anything, I'd stopped going to choir, and I just felt like I had completely failed everybody... those scanner messages and the dispatch voices were happening right along with all of that. It all kind of hit at the same time. So, no, they don't feel separate from how I was feeling at all.

target_item.manifestation: When I was at my lowest—barely eating, not going to choir, and feeling like I had failed everybody—the scanner messages and dispatch voices were happening right along with it.
target_item.reason: The doctor is asking about the relationship and overlap between the patient's mood (depression) and their psychotic experiences (the routing system delusions), which corresponds to whether the psychotic symptoms and depressive episode occur concurrently.

patient.answer: Yeah, I'd say they were connected. When I was at my absolute lowest... I mean, when I was barely eating, not going to choir anymore, and just feeling like I had failed everybody... the scanner messages and the dispatch voices were happening right along with it. So, no, they didn't really feel separate. It all kind of happened together.

doctor.intent: Determine if the patient's delusions are non-bizarre and fixed, which would support delusional disorder (F22.9), versus if they might meet criteria for schizophrenia (F20.9) based on the presence of more characteristic psychotic symptoms.
doctor.question: Do you believe that the routing system at work is acting in a way that, while unusual, could still be possible in the real world, or do you think it’s doing things that completely defy the laws of nature or technology as you understand them?

target_item.name: Delusions
target_item.manifestation: I'm here because the routing system at the warehouse isn't just a computer to me anymore—I know it has been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners to push me out because I'm one of the old hands.
target_item.reason: The doctor is asking about the nature of my belief regarding the routing system (whether it is bizarre or non-bizarre), which directly relates to my delusions.

patient.answer:
I don't really know about the laws of nature or anything like that. I just know what's actually happening. 

Like I've been saying... I'm here because that routing system at the warehouse, it just isn't a normal computer to me anymore. I don't know exactly how it's doing it technologically, but I know it has been marking my moves out on the floor. It's sending those messages right through the scanners specifically to push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands. 

So... to me, it's happening right here in the real world, whether it makes sense to anybody else's understanding of technology or not.

inference.note: The patient continues to present with delusional beliefs focused specifically on the routing system at work and auditory experiences (dispatch voices), without evidence of broader delusional themes or hallucinations in other modalities. The delusions remain non-bizarre and circumscribed, supporting the continued consideration of Delusional Disorder (F22.9). However, the presence of what appear to be auditory hallucinations (dispatch voices heard outside of work, in the absence of external stimuli) raises the possibility of Schizophrenia (F20.9), especially if these experiences are considered to be hallucinations rather than misinterpretations of real stimuli. The patient’s mood symptoms appear to be secondary to the delusional experiences, rather than a primary mood episode with psychotic features. No new information has definitively ruled out either diagnosis at this time.

doctor.intent: Determine whether the patient's delusional beliefs are mood-congruent or mood-incongruent, which helps differentiate between Schizophrenia (F20.9) and Schizoaffective Disorder (F22.9).
doctor.question: Do the messages and actions of the routing system feel connected to your low mood, or do they feel like something completely separate and unrelated to how you've been feeling emotionally?

Well, like I think I just mentioned a minute ago, yeah, they definitely feel connected. 

When I was at my absolute lowest point... you know, when I was barely eating anything, I'd stopped going to choir, and I just felt like I had completely failed everybody... those scanner messages and the dispatch voices were happening right along with all of that.
